contentMap.productCategory: AI Image Generation and AI Video Generation
contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals creating high-quality visual content, including creative teams, designers, art directors, video producers, marketing managers, and enterprise buyers

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description:
Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs.
The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Additional Feature
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description:
Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together.
Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

referenceMap.heroPattern: Single-screen hero with logo lockup, large left-aligned headline, short subheadline, and compact trust-badge row beneath. Visual hierarchy is text-first, with minimal ornamentation and a strong conversion CTA near the top. Uses a clean, enterprise-style banner rather than a media-led hero.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Top hero band followed by a lead-capture form block, then stacked feature sections with clear heading, paragraph, and bullet-like benefit list. The page favors long-form vertical progression over modular cards or multi-column exploration. Sections feel separated by simple spacing and container resets rather than heavy dividers.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Predominantly flat white cards/blocks with subtle borders and restrained styling. Information is presented in dense, utility-oriented panels rather than decorative glass or shadow-heavy cards. Any card treatment should remain simple, rectangular, and enterprise-oriented.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA is singular and action-oriented in the hero, reinforced by a secondary conversion form immediately below. Product sections may include a localized CTA at the end of the intro block, but the overall pattern is one main conversion path with repeated inquiry intent rather than multiple competing actions.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing module appears in the reference structure. If adapted, pricing should be treated as optional and deferred, likely below product explanation and trust-building content.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer is not visible in the provided structure; likely minimal or standard informational footer outside the core conversion flow.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: No dominant media panel in the main hero; the layout is text-forward. If media is used, it should be secondary and aligned with the section rather than full-bleed. Emphasis is on readable content blocks over imagery.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Stacked feature sections with repeated pattern: section headline, brief descriptive paragraph, then a list of benefit statements. The structure supports progressive disclosure and scannable technical details. Good fit for alternating long copy and concise bullet benefits.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form block immediately after hero, acting as a conversion bridge. The form is visually separated in its own card/container and likely uses hidden tracking inputs plus standard fields. This suggests a high-intent inquiry flow rather than inline micro-conversion.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, utility-driven presentation with no evident motion system. If motion is introduced, it should remain subtle and functional rather than decorative.

personality.buyer: Creative teams, designers, art directors, video producers, marketing managers, and enterprise buyers
personality.emotion: Awe, creative control, premium innovation, and enterprise-grade confidence
personality.reasoning: This product is clearly in the AI category because it centers on generative models for image and video creation. Per the rules, it must use the cinematic-ai family with a deep near-black purple-leaning foundation, but to satisfy the brand color constraint, the actual palette is derived from Techjockey’s brand colors: orange as the primary hero and CTA color, supported by white, charcoal, and soft grey. Since recent AI pages already used split-left, centered, and full-bleed heroes plus tabs/accordion-style features, this concept intentionally shifts to a fresher visual system: a full-bleed cinematic hero with layered media, spotlight cards, and split-panel feature storytelling. The result feels premium, interactive, and distinct while staying brand-consistent and conversion-focused.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long and benefits from a slightly reduced hero size to maintain elegance and avoid awkward line breaks while still feeling bold and premium.

colours.colourReason: Techjockey’s brand palette is orange, white, charcoal, and light grey. Orange becomes the hero background and primary CTA color, while the rest of the system uses dark cinematic surfaces to fit the AI category without introducing unsupported gradient colors.

layout.heroBackground: Full-bleed orange hero with a dark translucent overlay, layered floating product shells, and cinematic media framing to create a bold AI-first opening without reusing split or centered hero patterns.
layout.heroReason: A full-bleed treatment gives this AI product a more cinematic, premium feel and avoids the recently used split-left, centered, and standard full-bleed patterns by shifting the composition toward layered, poster-like storytelling.
layout.featureReason: Alternating sections create a fresh structure for the two core products: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro. Each gets its own visual rhythm, with split-panel storytelling, spotlight cards, and proof-style callouts instead of tabs or accordions.
layout.darkSectionFor: AI video generation section, comparison blocks, and proof bars use dark cinematic panels to heighten contrast and make motion-focused content feel more immersive.

personality.imageryDirection: Use cinematic AI product visuals rather than literal stock imagery: layered mock prompts, floating output frames, audio waveform ribbons, model chips, and visual-to-video transformation panels. For the hero, use a wide JPEG-style compositional scene with abstract generated imagery, UI overlays, and subtle glow reflections. Support with PNG UI shells and SVG icons throughout.

Use layered media frames on the right side of the composition to show image-to-video creative transformation without relying on a traditional split-layout template.

If shown, convert this into a short enterprise-confidence proof section with three to four flat glass cards. Use concise value points such as demo support, buying guidance, enterprise suitability, and faster evaluation. Maintain a utility-first tone and avoid decorative excess.

Present pricing as an optional decision-support block after feature explanation. Use two simple rectangular pricing cards with restrained borders, one for Seedream 4.5 and one for Seedance 1.5 Pro. Emphasize inquiry-led conversion with 'Get Quote' CTAs and keep the layout comparison-friendly rather than promotional.

With five testimonials, use a carousel to reduce vertical length and maintain momentum. Feature quote cards with author, designation, and subtle company metadata. Keep the styling premium and readable, with soft borders and enough spacing for enterprise credibility.

Use a focused lead-capture card with minimal fields and a clear conversion path. Since the provided input has no defined fields, keep the form lean and visually prominent, ideally in a floating glass card on a light surface. Prioritize clarity and frictionless inquiry submission.
If no media/news logos are available, render this as a minimal footer-adjacent logo strip or omit content visually. Keep it subtle and non-intrusive, preserving the main conversion flow.

features.alt: This video presents a calm and peaceful indoor setting, bathed in the warm glow of a sunset. The overall mood is serene and comfortable, with a static activity level. The visual style is pixel art, reminiscent of retro video games, giving it an artistic and nostalgic aesthetic. The room features a bookshelf filled with books, various potted plants, and a comfortable-looking armchair with a cute cat-face pillow. Sunlight streams through a large window, creating bright, warm-toned light patterns on the wooden floor. The color palette is dominated by oranges, yellows, and browns, with touches of green from the plants, creating a high-saturation, inviting atmosphere. tw-object-cover

This image depicts a dynamic, high-energy scene of a modern train traversing diverse weather conditions, representing four distinct seasons. The overall mood is dramatic and visually striking, showcasing the train's resilience. The setting is outdoor, featuring mountainous landscapes in various states: snowy peaks, barren rocks, and hazy desert. The visual style is realistic with a touch of artistic exaggeration to highlight the extreme weather. The emotional tone is powerful and adventurous, emphasizing journey and endurance. The central subject is a sleek, white and blue passenger train. The artistic style is photorealistic, with clear details in the train and surrounding environment. The color characteristics are highly saturated and varied, transitioning from cool blues and whites in the winter storm to warm oranges and yellows in the sunny and dusty desert scenes. The color palette shifts from blue and white to warm orange, yellow, and earthy brown tones. tw-object-cover

This video features a mysterious, sleek gray mannequin-like figure holding up a digital scoreboard at a sports stadium. The mood is calm and slightly surreal, with a bright, outdoor setting under a clear sky. The activity level is static, focusing on the mannequin and the scoreboard. The visual style is modern and realistic, with a subtle artistic touch due to the mannequin's appearance. The emotional tone is neutral, perhaps slightly intriguing. The main subject is the mannequin, dressed in a striped shirt, holding a black digital scoreboard displaying "11:22" in red LED lights. The background shows blurred stadium seating filled with an audience, suggesting a sporting event. The artistic style leans towards photorealism with a high-tech element. The color characteristics are cool tones, primarily grays, blues, and whites, with vibrant red highlights from the scoreboard. The color palette consists mainly of cool grays, light blue, and bright red. tw-object-cover

This video depicts a bright, calm, and spacious indoor setting of a modern minimalist smart home. The atmosphere is peaceful and serene, with a static camera view showcasing the interior design. The visual style is realistic and contemporary, emphasizing clean lines and understated elegance. Key elements include a large living area with a sofa, a sleek kitchen island with a sink, a fireplace with active flames, and a wall-mounted smart display showing various controls. The color characteristics are warm tones, dominated by muted pastels and earthy neutrals like beige, cream, and light wood, with subtle orange highlights from the sun and fireplace. The overall color palette is light and inviting, creating a sense of comfort and sophistication. tw-object-cover

This video features a bright and whimsical scene with a cheerful, fantastical atmosphere. The setting is an outdoor, natural environment, depicting a vibrant green hill under a clear blue sky with soft, wispy clouds. The activity level is static, focusing on a single, charming subject. The visual style is highly artistic and illustrative, reminiscent of a cartoon or children's book, with a touch of photorealism in the textures. The emotional tone is peaceful, joyful, and imaginative. The main subject is an adorable, round house shaped like a donut, complete with pink icing, colorful sprinkles, and a chimney made of stacked donuts, emitting a wisp of smoke. The windows and door are adorned with colorful candies, and warm light glows from within. The color characteristics are predominantly warm and pastel, with high saturation, creating a sweet and inviting palette of blues, greens, pinks, and various candy colors. tw-object-cover

Desktop.variantHint: split-layout if no media is provided; text-led hero with compact trust row
Desktop.notes: Build a strong enterprise hero with left-aligned text stack and a conversion CTA cluster. Since no media is provided, use a centered or text-dominant hero treatment within the dark primary background. Include badge row directly beneath supporting line. Secondary CTA remains visually present but empty only if required by component; otherwise omit in copy but keep layout slot if the design system expects it.

Desktop.variantHint: pill badges with dividers; compact enterprise strip
Desktop.notes: Place immediately under hero within a light grey or neutral band if separated as its own frame. Use four pill badges: AI Image Generation, AI Video Generation with Audio, Multimodal Content Creation, Enterprise-ready AI infrastructure. Since no customer count or social proof text is provided, do not invent stats.

Desktop.variantHint: minimal form block with single CTA; if fields are absent, use short inquiry form shell with generic enterprise lead fields only if required by system, otherwise present CTA-only inquiry module
Desktop.notes: This section is supported structurally by the reference pattern even though the input form object is empty. Keep it as a conversion block directly after trust. If no field content is supplied, use a slim form container with submit CTA and minimal placeholder layout, but avoid adding field labels/content in the plan. Purpose is to preserve the long-form vertical conversion flow.

Desktop.variantHint: single-column intro block followed by 3-column feature grid on desktop
Desktop.notes: Use a section header followed by a descriptive paragraph and a localized CTA. Below that, render feature bullets as flat cards or compact stacked benefit items depending on available space. This section has five features, so use a 3-column grid with wrapping to two rows per design memory. Keep card styling flat, white, bordered, enterprise-oriented.

Desktop.variantHint: single-column intro block followed by 3-column feature grid on desktop
Desktop.notes: Present as a second stacked product explanation block. No CTA is provided, so keep only the section intro and feature grid. This section also has five features, so use a 3-column grid with the final two cards wrapping into a second row. Maintain identical visual system to the first product section for consistency.

Desktop.variantHint: 2-up pricing cards with quote-style CTA; keep centered and information-dense
Desktop.notes: Pricing is supported by the input and should appear after product explanation and before testimonials. Use two flat cards with strong price hierarchy. The image plan has no price, so leave price blank or use quote-only presentation. The video plan has Starting at $1,000/month/; preserve that exact text. Include included-features checklist and Get Quote CTAs. Since the reference says pricing is optional, keep this visually lighter than hero and features but still present.

Desktop.variantHint: 3-column desktop testimonial cards; gold stars, italic quote, bold author, grey designation
Desktop.notes: Use only the five supplied quotes. On desktop, structure as a 3-column card grid with cards aligned to the top; the fifth card can wrap to a second row or span according to grid rhythm. Include star rating, quote, author name, designation, and company where provided. Keep card styling flat with a colored left border as per design memory.

Desktop.variantHint: centered elevated summary card with price, includes, CTA, trust line
Desktop.notes: Include a compact cart-style conversion module only if the page system requires it and because CART is explicitly listed in extras. If used, make it a centered quote/request summary rather than a retail checkout. It should summarize the two products and reinforce enquiry intent. Keep it visually subordinate to pricing and testimonials.

Footer is explicitly supported in extras. Use a standard Techjockey footer block with no invented navigation beyond generic legal/support structure. Keep it minimal and non-dominant so conversion sections remain primary.

Mobile.variantHint: text-first stacked hero with CTA buttons full width
Mobile.notes: On mobile, stack hero content vertically. Keep the headline readable with reduced size and ensure the primary CTA is full-width. Trust badges should wrap into two rows or a compact horizontal scroll row if needed, but avoid dense multi-line clutter.

Mobile.variantHint: wrapped badge chips or scrollable chip row
Mobile.notes: Keep badges compact and scannable. If space is tight, use a vertically stacked badge cluster with two badges per row. Do not add customer counts or extra proof text not supplied.

Mobile.variantHint: single-column inquiry block with full-width submit CTA
Mobile.notes: Maintain the conversion block directly after trust. If the empty form object is treated literally, keep this as a reserved layout shell for lead capture rather than adding unprovided fields. Ensure the mobile stack keeps the CTA prominent.

Convert the 5-feature grid to a single-column list on mobile. Preserve the section intro, then present each feature as a stacked bordered card or compact list item. Keep the CTA at section end if used in the desktop plan.
Mirror product-1 structure for consistency. Keep the intro paragraph readable and compress the feature list into one column. Avoid multi-column cards on mobile.

Mobile.variantHint: 2 stacked pricing cards with clear quote CTA
Mobile.notes: Use stacked cards on mobile for clarity. Keep the quoted starting price readable and maintain the includes checklist. The price section should stay below product explanation and above testimonials.

Mobile.variantHint: single-column card stack, optionally horizontally scrollable if space constraints occur
Mobile.notes: Render the five testimonials as stacked cards. Keep star rating visible, quote italicized, and metadata compact. No additional testimonial copy should be invented.

Mobile.variantHint: full-width card, shadow removed on mobile
Mobile.notes: If included, the cart module should become a simple full-width CTA card with minimal visual weight. Avoid checkout-like complexity; treat as a quote summary or inquiry reinforcement panel.
End with a compact mobile footer. Keep it lightweight and unobtrusive.
